checkpoints.name: Phase 7H issuer key snapshot and revocation

release_blockers.evidence: Phase 7A APK was blocked as harmful; appeal submitted but no favorable determination confirmed. Existing Phase7A debug APK is preserved as archived appeal evidence. Its workflow now compiles/tests only and no longer uploads an APK on future runs.
release_blockers.next_action: Obtain an official classification outcome and safe distribution/security review; do not turn off protection or force install.

release_blockers.evidence: Historical KeyPrep TEST CI debug signer differs across builds; original installed APK signer/private signing key continuity unverified.
release_blockers.next_action: Verify installed signer and authorized signing-key custody. Preserve original KeyPrep; do not uninstall, clear or overwrite.

release_blockers.evidence: Supabase hosted Magic Link email template and current provider settings not readable via prior connector audit. TEST project is ACTIVE_HEALTHY on a Free organization plan and created 2026-10-14. Supabase restricted new Free projects with default SMTP from customizing Auth email templates starting 2026-06-03; actual Auth custom SMTP/template state remains unverified.
release_blockers.next_action: Read-only inspect TEST Authentication > SMTP and Email Templates > Magic Link. If using default SMTP on Free, configure a verified custom SMTP provider or paid tier before changing the template to {{ .Token }}. Verify delivery and rate limits with authorized TEST accounts only; never expose OTP.

release_blockers.evidence: Real signed AndroidKeyStore challenge using live TEST user JWT not executed; Edge feature gate is hard-disabled.
release_blockers.next_action: After Play Protect clearance and signing continuity, independently review a scoped TEST verification plan; keep trust promotion OFF.

release_blockers.evidence: No verified real external issuer/reviewer authority established; Phase 5/7G/7H use synthetic identities.
release_blockers.next_action: Select and audit accountable real identity provider, key custody, independent human reviewers, consent, disputes, revocation and privacy.

release_blockers.evidence: Phase 7G/H are review-only, Phase 7I is hard HOLD; no independently approved live first-device transaction.
release_blockers.next_action: Design separately reviewed trust authorization and audit, then perform safety evaluation before any scoped TEST rollout.

release_blockers.evidence: No verified end-to-end two-physical-phone flows for identity continuity, E2EE, calling, messaging, email and UPI trust chain.
release_blockers.next_action: After approved first-device flow, test two physical phones and each feature with fail-closed negative cases.

release_blockers.evidence: CI and internal code review do not constitute third-party penetration testing or legal/regulatory clearance.
release_blockers.next_action: Obtain independent security review, threat model, external audit logs, incident response, privacy and compliance review.
